business_summary: Globalway, Inc. engages in the digital solution, career innovation, and sharing business activities in Japan. The company provides IT consulting and platform construction support services, including DevOps-related solutions; service cloud / field service lighting implementation; salescloud implementation; sales cloud fast start; service cloud fast start; salesforce security assessment; and B2B commerce / experience cloud implementation support services. It also offers system development infrastructure construction support; API infrastructure construction support; support for building a system integration platform; data analysis infrastructure support; IOT infrastructure construction; free Python education service; and workflow system infrastructure construction support services. In addition, it provides MuleSoft implementation support services. Further, the company offers Career Connection, a company review service; Career Connection Career Change, a job change/recruitment site; Career Connection News, a service news for business and careers; Career Connection Company Research  Risako, a useful information site for job changes and stock investments; Mid-career recruitment success, a software for corporate recruiters; NEXT DX LEADER, a useful information site; and Globalway high-class Agent, a high-class recruitment service site. Additionally, it provides TimeTicket, a sharing economy service; TimeTicket Pro, a service that allows to sell personal time between corporations and individuals; and CRiPT consulting, that tackles the various management and social challenges. Globalway, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
